teaser.en: To protect a crop, some Digo farmers gently throw sorghum grains onto the growing plants.
teaser.sw: Ili kulinda zao, baadhi ya wakulima wa Kidigo hurusha kwa upole punje za mtama juu ya mimea inayokua.
teaser.dg: Ili kurinda zao, akurima anjina Adigo nkutsuphira tembe za *mhama* pore-pore dzulu ya mimea inayomera.

summary.en: *Mhama* is sorghum, a drought-tolerant grain of the drier inland farms. It is eaten as porridge and *ugali* and also used in a protective farming rite.
summary.sw: *Mhama* ni mtama, nafaka inayostahimili ukame inayolimwa katika mashamba makavu ya bara. Huliwa kama uji na *ugali*, na pia hutumika katika tambiko la kulinda mazao.
summary.dg: *Mhama* ni mtama, nafaka inayovumirira ukame, ya minda ya kahi ya tsi, iriyo kavu zaidi. Nkuriwa dza uji na *sima*, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwenye mila ya chirimo ya kurinda zao.

about.en:
*Mhama* is a tall cereal grass with broad leaves and a stout stem topped by a dense head of rounded grains. It looks a little like maize before it flowers, but bears its grain in a head at the top rather than on cobs.

Digo farmers name several kinds: *muhama mrefu* (tall), *muhama wa bombo* (reddish) and *muhama wa fumbula* (with a large head).
about.sw:
*Mhama* ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye majani mapana na bua nene lenye kichwa kilichoshonana cha punje za mviringo juu yake. Unafanana kidogo na mhindi kabla ya kutoa maua, lakini huzaa punje zake kwenye kichwa kilicho juu badala ya kwenye magunzi.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hutaja aina kadhaa: *muhama mrefu* (mrefu), *muhama wa bombo* (mwekundu kiasi) na *muhama wa fumbula* (wenye kichwa kikubwa).
about.dg:
*Mhama* ni nyasi ndefu ya nafaka yenye makodza mapana na mlita muziho, wenye chitswa chikulu cha tembe za duara zirizobanana dzuluche. Unaonekana chidide dza pemba kabla ya kulavya maruwa, ela tembeze zinamera kpwenye chitswa dzulu badala ya kpwenye matsere.

Akurima Adigo anaiha aina kadhaa: *muhama mrefu* (mure), *muhama wa bombo* (wa rangi ya kundu-kundu) na *muhama wa fumbula* (wenye chitswa chikulu).

where.en: Sorghum is grown on the drier farms inland, where rainfall is less reliable and maize can fail. It stands up well to drought.
where.sw: Mtama hulimwa katika mashamba makavu ya bara, ambako mvua haitegemewi sana na mahindi yanaweza kukosa kuzaa. Unastahimili ukame vizuri.
where.dg: *Mhama* nkurimwa kpwenye minda iriyo kavu zaidi ya kahi ya tsi, ambako mvula taiaminika na pemba inaweza kukosa kuvyala. Unavumirira ukame vinono.

uses.en: The grain is ground for porridge and for *ugali*.

culture.en: Sorghum also has a ritual role: a protective rite involves gently throwing sorghum grains onto plants.
culture.sw: Mtama pia una nafasi katika matambiko: tambiko moja la kinga huhusisha kurusha kwa upole punje za mtama juu ya mimea.
culture.dg: *Mhama* piya una kazi ya chimila: mila mwenga ya kurinda zao ni kutsuphira tembe za *mhama* pore-pore dzulu ya mimea.

names.en: Digo: *mhama* in Mgombato, *muhama* in Pakia. Mgombato glosses *mhama* as 'millet', with the Swahili *mtama*, but *mtama* normally means sorghum, and Pakia translates *muhama* as sorghum. Swahili: *mtama*. English: sorghum. Scientists call it *Sorghum bicolor*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mhama* katika Mgombato, *muhama* katika Pakia. Mgombato inaeleza *mhama* kuwa 'millet', ikitoa Kiswahili *mtama*, lakini kwa kawaida *mtama* humaanisha *sorghum*, na Pakia anatafsiri *muhama* kuwa *sorghum*. Kiswahili: *mtama*. Kiingereza: *sorghum*. Wanasayansi huuita *Sorghum bicolor*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mhama* kpwenye Mgombato na *muhama* kpwa Pakia. Mgombato inaringanisha *mhama* na 'millet', na Chiswahili *mtama*, ela *mtama* kawaida ni *sorghum*, na Pakia anatafsiri *muhama* dza *sorghum*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtama*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sorghum*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sorghum bicolor*.

reason.en: Pearl millet, a similar dry-land cereal
reason.sw: Uwele, nafaka nyingine kama huu ya nchi kavu
reason.dg: *Pearl millet*, nafaka yanjina sawa nao ya tsi kavu

reason.en: Rice, another grass grown for grain
reason.sw: Mpunga, nyasi nyingine inayolimwa kwa ajili ya nafaka
reason.dg: Mphunga, nyasi yanjina inayorimwa kpwa sababu ya tembe

reason.en: Sugar cane, a related tall grass
reason.sw: Muwa, nyasi ndefu ya jamii moja nao
reason.dg: Muwa, nyasi ndefu ya jamii mwenga nao
